fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the message.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: The tenant unique identifier associated with the message.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: The unique identifier of the user who created the message.

fields.name: created_by_username
fields.description: The username of the user who created the message.

fields.name: created_on
fields.description: The timestamp when the message was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the message was last updated.

fields.name: thread_id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the thread the message belongs to.

fields.name: parent_message_id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the parent message, if any.

fields.name: role
fields.description: The role of the sender (Example: user and assistant).

fields.name: content
fields.description: The message content, either as a list content objects or string.

fields.name: mentions
fields.description: List of mentions included in the message.

fields.name: assistant_id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the AI assistant.

fields.name: assistant_name
fields.description: The name of the assistant.

fields.name: is_default
fields.description: Indicates whether this is the default assistant.

fields.name: type
fields.description: - route_complete - route_confirm - nba_selection - message_created - form_submission - route_error - nba_selection_error

fields.name: top_n_tokens
fields.description: Include top N candidate tokens at the position of each returned token. The maximum value that is permitted is 5, but more might be returned if there is a tie for nth place.

fields.name: decay_factor
fields.description: Represents the factor of exponential decay. Larger values correspond to more aggressive decay.

fields.name: start_index
fields.description: A number of generated tokens after which this should take effect.

fields.name: beam_width
fields.description: Specifies the number of beams that are used in beam search decoding. A higher value allows for a more exhaustive search, potentially improving the quality of the output at the cost of computational complexity.

fields.name: decoding_method
fields.description: Represents the strategy that is used for picking the tokens during generation of the output text. Possible values include 'greedy' for deterministic generation and 'sample' for stochastic generation.

fields.name: include_stop_sequence
fields.description: Pass `false` to omit matched stop sequences from the end of the output text. The default is `true`, meaning that the output ends with the stop sequence text when matched.

fields.name: length_penalty
fields.description: It can be used to exponentially increase the likelihood of the text generation terminating once a specified number of tokens have been generated.

fields.name: max_new_tokens
fields.description: The maximum number of new tokens to be generated. It limits the length of the generated output, preventing it from exceeding a specified size.

fields.name: min_new_tokens
fields.description: If stop sequences are given, they are ignored until minimum tokens are generated. The minimum number of new tokens to be generated.

fields.name: random_seed
fields.description: Random number generator seed to use in sampling mode for experimental repeatability.

fields.name: repetition_penalty
fields.description: Represents the penalty for penalizing tokens that have already been generated or belong to the context. The value 1.0 means that there is no penalty.

fields.name: stop_sequences
fields.description: Stop sequences are one or more strings which will cause the text generation to stop if/when they are produced as part of the output.

fields.name: temperature
fields.description: A value used to modify the next-token probabilities in sampling mode. Values less than 1.0 sharpen the probability distribution, resulting in \"less random\" output. Values greater than 1.0 flatten the probability distribution, resulting in \"more random\" output. A value of 1.0 has no effect.

fields.name: time_limit
fields.description: Time limit in milliseconds - if not completed within this time, generation stops. The text generated so far is returned along with the TIME_LIMIT stop reason.

fields.name: top_k
fields.description: The number of highest probability vocabulary tokens to keep for top-k-filtering. Only applies for sampling mode. When decoding_strategy is set to sample, only the top_k most likely tokens are considered as candidates for the next generated token.

fields.name: top_p
fields.description: Similar to top_k except the candidates to generate the next token are the most likely tokens with probabilities that add up to at least top_p. Also known as nucleus sampling. A value of 1.0 is equivalent to disabled.

fields.name: truncate_input_tokens
fields.description: Truncates the input to a specified number of tokens to prevent exceeding token limits, which may cause request failures.

fields.name: typical_p
fields.description: Measures typicality to control how predictable the next token is compared to the expected randomness. Lower values lead to more diverse outputs.

fields.name: response_type
fields.description: search, text, user_defined

fields.name: channels
fields.description: An array of objects that specify channels for which the response is intended. If **channels** are present, the response is intended for a built-in integration and should not be handled by an API client.

types.name: AccessToken
types.description: AccessToken generation  two ways to auth that require slightly different URLs api.dl.watson-orchestrate.ibm.com - uses bearer tokens derived from the IAM-API-KEY [ in config ] api.us-south.watson-orchestrate.cloud.ibm.com - old style, uses IAM-API-KEY directly Note: for now we pass in both the Authorization and IAM-API_KEY to calls; this means non-ibm cloud calls have IAM-API-TOKEN showing.  Fix later.
